disclaimer: These notices are treated as messages that arrived at the linked university mailbox. TermPilot does not scrape a university portal and does not speak as the dean, union or a counsellor.

items.title: Students' Union: welcome fair and academic reps
items.summary: Visit the SU advice desk and elect course reps. TermPilot signposts; it is not your union.

items.title: Careers service: autumn internship clinic
items.summary: Book a short CV clinic with the university careers team. No applications are sent for you.

items.title: Student support: wellbeing drop-in this week
items.summary: Confidential university wellbeing drop-in. TermPilot is not a counselling or crisis service.

items.title: International office: enrolment and CAS checklist
items.summary: Bring passport, visa or BRP, and enrolment letter. Visa rules stay on GOV.UK — not guessed here.

items.title: Faculty office: library 24-hour opening starts Monday
items.summary: Operational notice from the faculty office. This is not a message impersonating a dean.
